thread:
Zoe: quick glance at recurring incidents this quarter. clustering found a few repeat vectors. posting a short list + proposed owners so we can open tracked tickets. ping if you want to take something.

OpsBot: Recurrence scan complete 5 clusters detected in 90d. Summary: pool-saturation (10), deploy-metadata-bugs (7), warmup-lapses (6), external-rate-limits (4), config-drift (3). Dashboard: https://internal/dash/recurrence-q1-2026

Dan: can you paste the short counts and top symptom for each?

Zoe: sure:
- pool-saturation: 10 incidents, spikes at model swap windows -> pages and escalations.
- deploy-metadata-bugs: 7 incidents, missing pool/tagging metadata leads to misrouted traffic.
- warmup-lapses: 6 incidents, tail latency after model swaps.
- external-rate-limits: 4 incidents, vendor throttles on embedding calls.
- config-drift: 3 incidents, autoscaler and pool tag regressions after infra changes.

Priya: I'll take external-rate-limits. Plan: retry matrix + circuit breaker + quota telemetry. ETA 2 weeks.

Marco: I can own deploy-metadata-bugs. Will add a CI schema linter + a post-deploy verifier. ETA 10 days.

Dan: I'll handle pool-saturation short-term (temporary pool margin during swaps). Long-term autoscaler smoothing to follow. Short ETA 1 week for temp fix.

Zoe: proposed actions (I'll open tickets and add recurrence_reason field):
```
- ACT-1845: Pool margin during model swaps. Owner: Dan. ETA: 2026-04-08. Deliverables: config patch, load test, alert tweak.
- ACT-1846: Deploy metadata linter + verifier. Owner: Marco. ETA: 2026-04-12. Deliverables: linter, CI gate, runbook.
- ACT-1847: Warmup prefetch & gauge. Owner: unassigned (please volunteer). ETA: 2026-04-22.
- ACT-1848: External-rate-limit strategy. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-04-05. Deliverables: retry middleware, circuit breaker config, telemetry.
- ACT-1849: Config-drift detection job. Owner: Zoe. ETA: 2026-04-10. Deliverables: periodic diff job, alerting, PR linter rules.
```

OpsBot: Reminder: Any ACTION without an owner after 48h will be assigned to oncall.

Priya: product needs to sign off on retry budget. Zoe, can you coordinate?

Zoe: yes, will loop in product and add a "user-impact" metric to the ticket.

Marco: note : linter will include required fields: pool, region, canary, version. will start a PR.

Dan: will prototype pool-margin change and post perf numbers by Thu.

Zoe: thanks. I'll create the ENG tickets and schedule a 30m check-in next Tue to review progress. If anyone else wants to take ACT-1847 (warmup), call it out here. :white_check_mark:
